notes.title: More achievements!
notes.content:
Greetings Dungeon Heroes,

There are now 18 additional achievements to unlock! Some of these will be more challenging than others.

Thank you for playing and happy achievement hunting!

notes.title: Steam achievement and music fix
notes.content:
Update details:


Added a single Steam achievement, unlock it by using the portal.
Changed the background music in the castle levels.

Thank you for playing and happy adventuring!
